title: RECAP: Context-Aware Prediction Recycling with Request-Local and Persistent Memories for Multimodal Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.05894v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recycling a target model's own predictions offers a training-free source of proposals for speculative decoding. In vision-language models, however, existing recycling indexes predictions by the last token alone, conflating predictions computed under different images and prefixes; we find that such reuse fails most often at image-sensitive decoding states. Longer keys reduce this aliasing but match fewer states. We introduce \method, which stores target predictions under one-, two-, and three-token keys: contextual memories live only for the current request and are thus implicitly conditioned on its image, while token-level memory persists across requests to retain coverage. At each lookup, entropy-confidence weighting fuses the retrieved predictions according to their key specificity and concentration. Best-first search composes the fused transitions into a candidate tree, supplemented by suffix-matched continuations, and one target pass

translated_title: RECAP：面向多模态投机解码的基于请求本地与持久记忆的上下文感知预测回收
translated_abstract: 回收目标模型自身的预测为投机解码提供了一种无需训练的候选提案来源。然而，在视觉-语言模型中，现有的回收方法仅通过最后一个token来索引预测，这将不同图像和前缀下计算得到的预测混为一谈；我们发现这种复用在图像敏感的解码状态下最容易失效。更长的键可以减少这种混叠，但匹配到的状态也更少。我们提出了RECAP方法，它将目标预测存储在一、二、三token长度的键下：上下文记忆仅在当前请求中存活，因此隐式地以该请求的图像为条件，而token级记忆则跨请求持久存在以保持覆盖率。在每次查找时，熵-置信度加权根据键的特异性和集中度对检索到的预测进行融合。最佳优先搜索将融合后的状态转移组合成候选树，并由后缀匹配的延续序列加以补充，最后通过一次目标模型的前向传递（对候选进行验证）……
tldr: 提出RECAP方法，通过区分请求本地的上下文记忆与跨请求持久的token级记忆、多长度键存储及熵置信度加权融合，实现无需训练的多模态投机解码预测回收，有效解决图像敏感解码状态下的预测混叠问题。
en_tdlr: RECAP enables training-free prediction recycling for multimodal speculative decoding by combining request-local contextual memories with persistent token-level memories under multi-length keys, using entropy-confidence weighted fusion to resolve prediction aliasing at image-sensitive decoding states.
